doc: BiGG exchange REACTION ids, read from BiGG's reaction list. An exchange id outside this set is BiGG-shaped and names no BiGG reaction; the documented COBRApy adoption path drops it silently. Version 1 of this file held metabolite stems and asked whether the metabolite has an extracellular form, which is a proxy, not the question: f_e exists in BiGG and EX_f_e does not.
